Definition: to laugh (in pleasure or detraction); by implication, to play
BiblicalUsage: 1) to laugh, play, mock; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to laugh (usually in contempt or derision); 1a2) to sport, play; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to make sport; 1b2) to jest; 1b3) to play (including instrumental music, singing, dancing); 1c) (Hiphil) to laugh mockingly
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
